/projects/eyewear-shoot.title: Timex Eyewear Photoshoot — Kashish Shah
/projects/eyewear-shoot.description: Art directing and conceptualising a Timex Eyewear campaign through visual storytelling and photography.
p: Campaign Conceptualisation, Art Direction, Visual Storytelling
Art directing and conceptualising a Timex Eyewear campaign through visual storytelling and photography.

A fashion-led photoshoot that celebrates eyewear as an expression of personal style. Through confident poses, statement styling and a mix of classic and contemporary looks, the shoot captures individuality and effortless sophistication, positioning Timex Eyewear as bold, versatile and timeless.

Inspired by Mumbai’s contrasting character, the campaign explores the warmth of its old architecture and the coolness of its modern cityscape, from glass skyscrapers to the waterfront. This contrast was translated into the photography through warm and cool tones, creating a visual story that reflects the city’s evolving identity and Timex Eyewear’s timeless style.

/about.title: About — Kashish Shah
/about.description: Learn about Kashish Shah’s approach to communication design, research, storytelling and visual culture.
p: communication designer, researcher and observer. drawn to the stories, systems and visual languages that shape how we see the world.

I work across branding, storytelling, research, typography, packaging and digital experiences. I’m drawn to where culture and contemporary life meet: in crafts, objects, archives, streets and everyday rituals. My process begins with looking closer, asking better questions and understanding the context before shaping a visual response.
Drawing, painting, dancing, travelling and collecting small observations that often find their way into my work.

I see design as a way of translating what is already there into something people can see, feel and engage with. Research gives a project its depth. Storytelling gives it meaning. Design makes it tangible.
